question: What is the warranty period on laptops sold at ElectroMart India?
answer: All laptops come with an official manufacturer warranty ranging from 1 to 3 years. We also offer ElectroMart Extended Care providing an additional 1 or 2 years of coverage.

question: What is the replacement and return policy?
answer: We offer a 7-day hassle-free replacement policy for defective or damaged electronics. The product must have original box, accessories, and invoice.

question: What payment methods do you accept?
answer: We accept UPI (Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm), Credit & Debit cards (Visa, MasterCard, RuPay), Net Banking, and Cash on Delivery up to ₹15,000.

question: Are there any No-Cost EMI options available?
answer: Yes! We provide 0% interest No-Cost EMI for 3, 6, 9, and 12 months on all purchases above ₹20,000 with major credit cards and Bajaj Finserv.

question: How long does standard delivery take?
answer: Standard metro delivery takes 24 to 48 hours. Tier-2 and Tier-3 cities receive delivery within 3 to 5 business days with live GPS tracking.

question: Can I test products hands-on in the physical store?
answer: Yes! You can book an appointment with our AI agent to visit your nearest ElectroMart showroom for a dedicated hands-on demo with an expert.

question: Which laptop is recommended for coding and software development?
answer: The CodeMaster Pro 15 (₹64,999) and DevForge Extreme 16 (₹79,999) are top picks. Both offer fast H-series processors, 16GB DDR5 RAM, and high-resolution displays.

question: What is the best budget laptop for students?
answer: The VoltBook Student 14 at ₹34,999 with 8GB RAM, 256GB SSD, and 8 hours of battery life is our most popular student choice.

question: Do you offer exchange value on old phones or laptops?
answer: Yes, our Trade-In program offers up to ₹5,000 extra exchange bonus over market valuation on working old devices with valid IMEI/serial numbers.

question: Which smartphone has the longest battery life?
answer: The Volt PowerMax 5G (₹13,999) features a massive 6000mAh monster battery that lasts up to 2.5 days on normal usage.

question: What gaming laptop under ₹1,00,000 is available?
answer: The CyberPulse G15 at ₹94,999 features an AMD Ryzen 7 7840HS, 16GB DDR5, and NVIDIA RTX 4060 8GB GPU with a 165Hz QHD panel.

question: Does the tablet come with a stylus pen included?
answer: The Zenith Pad Creator 12 includes the magnetic stylus in the box. For the NovaPad Air 11, the stylus is sold separately or at a discount bundle.

question: What are ElectroMart showroom hours?
answer: Showrooms are open Monday through Sunday from 10:00 AM to 08:30 PM. Sales consultations can be booked anytime.

question: Does the VoltCharge 100W GaN charger support laptops?
answer: Yes! Its USB-C Power Delivery 3.0 ports output up to 100W, sufficient to fast-charge MacBooks, Dell, HP, Lenovo, and NovaCorp laptops.

question: Can I upgrade RAM on the laptops after purchase?
answer: The CodeMaster Pro 15, DevForge Extreme 16, and ZenithBook Air 15 have upgradeable RAM slots without voiding the warranty.

question: Is there a student discount available?
answer: Yes! Our Student Tech Pass offer gives a flat ₹2,500 instant discount on laptops above ₹30,000 with a verified student ID.

question: Can I cancel an order before dispatch?
answer: Yes, orders can be cancelled with 100% full refund through the customer portal or helpline before shipping.

question: Which smartphone has optical image stabilization (OIS)?
answer: Both the Pulse Velocity 5G (₹16,999), Zenith CamPro 5G (₹34,999), and Aura Flagship X (₹64,999) feature hardware OIS.

question: What warranty does the Titan Fold Z have on its folding screen?
answer: The Titan Fold Z includes 2 years of VIP screen protection with a 1-time free inner screen replacement.

question: How do I reach customer support?
answer: Contact support via toll-free 1800-ELE-MART (1800-353-6278) or email support@electromart-india.example.com from 9 AM to 8 PM daily.

question: Can tablets be connected to external keyboards and monitors?
answer: Yes, Aura Slate Pro 13 and Zenith Pad Creator 12 support Type-C display output and magnetic/Bluetooth keyboard accessories.

question: Do you offer open-box delivery?
answer: Yes, open-box inspection is available across 15 major metro cities for all electronics priced above ₹20,000.

question: How effective is the ANC on Aura SoundBeats?
answer: Aura SoundBeats provides hybrid active noise cancellation up to 38dB, blocking low-frequency engine and office chatter.

question: Can I get a GST business tax invoice for input credit?
answer: Yes, simply enter your company name and 15-digit GSTIN during checkout or consultation to receive a compliant GST tax invoice.

question: Can I reschedule my booked store appointment?
answer: Yes, you can easily reschedule anytime by providing your appointment ID or email to our sales agent or helpline.
